title: EEG dataset for speech decoding
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from two related studies (2019 and 2021) investigating speech decoding through phoneme discrimination tasks combined with transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). Study 1 involved 8 participants performing discrimination of consonant-vowel and vowel-consonant phoneme pairs with TMS targeting motor cortex regions. Study 2 expanded to 16 participants and included single phonemes, phoneme pairs, and phoneme triplets (real and pseudowords) with additional TMS targets in Broca's area and supplementary motor area (SMA/BA 6). The dataset provides a comprehensive resource for investigating the neural mechanisms of speech perception and articulation.
methods_description: EEG recordings were collected during phoneme discrimination tasks with concurrent TMS stimulation. Study 1 (2019) included 8 participants performing CV and VC phoneme pair discrimination with TMS applied to left lip motor cortex (LipM1) and tongue motor cortex (TongueM1). Study 2 (2021) involved 16 participants discriminating single phonemes, CV/VC pairs, real words, and pseudowords with TMS targeting additional sites including Broca's area (BA 44) and supplementary motor area (SMA/BA 6). TMS was delivered using a Magstim Super Rapid Plus1 stimulator with a figure-of-eight 40 mm coil at 110% of resting motor threshold as paired pulses with 50 ms interpulse interval.
